display_name: Snapdeal formula pattern — TDS Reconciliation (Non-Order vs Settlement)
formula_sql:
SELECT
  n.sub_order_no,
  n.gross_amount AS non_order_tds,
  s.settled_amount AS settlement_tds,
  ABS(n.gross_amount) - ABS(s.settled_amount) AS variance
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_non_order n
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
  ON n.sub_order_no = s.item_id
  AND s.is_active = true
  AND LOWER(s.type) LIKE '%tds inv%'
WHERE n.is_active = true
  AND n.transaction_type LIKE '%TDS INV%';
